rationale: Lydia brings deep expertise in developer experience and technical education—areas directly relevant to building products that developers actually want to use—while Jia is building NimbleRx, a venture-backed company in the vertical SaaS and developer-tools space. Lydia's track record scaling DX at Bun and Vercel, combined with her ability to communicate complex technical concepts visually, could offer strategic perspective on how early-stage companies make their platforms accessible to technical users.
intro_message: Lydia Hallie, meet Jia Jin — Lydia leads developer experience at Anthropic and has scaled DX at venture-backed companies like Bun and Vercel, and Jia is a YC founder building in the developer-tools and vertical SaaS space.
